identity_note: Matched Eudia (eudia.com; legal entity Cicero Technologies, Inc. dba Eudia), the Palo Alto legal-AI company that has bought ALSPs. Not the French training firm 'EUDIA' on LinkedIn (/company/eudia) or EUDA Health; Eudia's own LinkedIn slug is /company/eudiahq.

profile.name: Eudia
profile.description: AI platform plus tech-enabled legal services for corporate legal departments and government: AI assistants/agents, contracting and compliance tools, forward-deployed lawyers, and an Arizona ABS law firm (Eudia Counsel).
profile.location: Palo Alto, CA (HQ); offices in New York, Irvine CA, Bengaluru (India) and Dublin (Ireland)
profile.founder: Omar Haroun (Co-Founder & CEO; previously founded Text IQ, sold to Relativity); co-founders Ashish Agrawal and David Van Reyk (per Wikipedia)
profile.funding_detail: Series A of up to $105M announced Feb 2025, led by General Catalyst with Floodgate and Sierra Ventures (~$30M upfront, ~$75M contingent on acquisitions approved by General Catalyst). No later round found as of 2026-10-08.
profile.headcount: 157 on LinkedIn (2026-10-08); prior pass recorded ~191-200 in mid-2026. Acquired ALSP staff (Johnson Hana 300+ legal professionals) may not all map to the Eudia LinkedIn page.
profile.past_completed_deals: Johnson Hana (Dublin ALSP, 300+ legal professionals, Jul 2025); Out-House (Maryland ALSP serving Fortune 500 legal departments, Oct 23, 2025). No acquisitions found in 2026.
profile.open_role: No corp-dev roles; hiring Engineering, Product, GTM (Account Director, Business Leads for federal/defense, Field Marketing, Solutions Consultant), Forward Deployed Lawyers, People Ops and Recruiting (20 open roles) as of 2026-10-08

verdict.headline: ALSP roll-up (2 deals in 2025) · no corp dev seat open
verdict.detail: Series A capital is partly earmarked for acquisitions, but 2026 news has been partnerships (OpenAI, Microsoft, ServiceNow, NVIDIA), not deals; CEO Omar Haroun is the decision-maker.
